briefdescription.para: VirtRegInfo - This list is a mapping from virtual register number to variable information.
HandlePhysRegKill - Add kills of Reg and its sub-registers to the uses.

detaileddescription.para: Pay special attention to the sub-register uses which may come below the last use of the whole register.

briefdescription.para: HandleRegMask - Call HandlePhysRegKill for all registers clobbered by Mask.
HandlePhysRegUse - Turn previous partial def's into read/mod/writes.

detaileddescription.para: Add implicit defs to a machine instruction if there was an earlier def of its super-register.

briefdescription.para: FindLastRefOrPartRef - Return the last reference or partial reference of the specified register.
FindLastPartialDef - Return the last partial def of the specified register.

detaileddescription.para: Also returns the sub-registers that're defined by the instruction.

briefdescription.para: analyzePHINodes - Gather information about the PHI nodes in here.

detaileddescription.para: In particular, we want to map the variable information of a virtual register which is used in a PHI node. We map that to the BB the vreg is coming from.

briefdescription.para: Recompute liveness from scratch for a virtual register Reg that is known to have a single def that dominates all uses.

detaileddescription.para: This can be useful after removing some uses of Reg. It is not necessary for the whole machine function to be in SSA form.

briefdescription.para: replaceKillInstruction - Update register kill info by replacing a kill instruction with a new one.
addVirtualRegisterKilled - Add information about the fact that the specified register is killed after being used by the specified instruction.

detaileddescription.para: If AddIfNotFound is true, add a implicit operand if it's not found.

briefdescription.para: removeVirtualRegisterKilled - Remove the specified kill of the virtual register from the live variable information.

detaileddescription.para: Returns true if the variable was marked as killed by the specified instruction, false otherwise.

briefdescription.para: removeVirtualRegistersKilled - Remove all killed info for the specified instruction.
addVirtualRegisterDead - Add information about the fact that the specified register is dead after being used by the specified instruction.

detaileddescription.para: If AddIfNotFound is true, add a implicit operand if it's not found.

briefdescription.para: removeVirtualRegisterDead - Remove the specified kill of the virtual register from the live variable information.

detaileddescription.para: Returns true if the variable was marked dead at the specified instruction, false otherwise.

briefdescription.para: getVarInfo - Return the VarInfo structure for the specified VIRTUAL register.

detaileddescription.para: getVarInfo - Get (possibly creating) a VarInfo object for the given vreg.

briefdescription.para: isLiveOut - Determine if Reg is live out from MBB, when not considering PHI nodes.

detaileddescription.para: This means that Reg is either killed by a successor block or passed through one.

briefdescription.para: addNewBlock - Add a new basic block BB between DomBB and SuccBB.

detaileddescription.para: addNewBlock - Add a new basic block BB as an empty succcessor to DomBB.
All variables that are live out of DomBB and live into SuccBB will be marked as passing live through BB. This method assumes that the machine code is still in SSA form.
All variables that are live out of DomBB will be marked as passing live through BB.

briefdescription.para: addNewBlock - Add a new basic block BB as an empty succcessor to DomBB.

detaileddescription.para: All variables that are live out of DomBB will be marked as passing live through BB. LiveInSets[BB] is not updated (because it is not needed during PHIElimination).
